summary: A Quote subscribe on MCX, an exchange Sahi does not stream. Today the desktop acknowledges it and sends Sahi a Subscribe for the token; the web's adapter refuses it before any lookup (sahi_adapter.py:202-205) and the web proxy answers an error item in a partial reply. This pins today's answer; Phase B turns it into the web's refusal through Broker::feed_refusal.

notes: The harness compares a reply with the case only (web.json holds published frames), so the web's answer is recorded here and in the lane report: {"type": "subscribe", "status": "partial", "subscriptions": [{"symbol": "CRUDEOIL25NOVFUT", "exchange": "MCX", "status": "error", "message": "Exchange MCX is not streamed by Sahi", "broker": "sahi"}], "message": "Subscription processing complete", "broker": "sahi"} (websocket_proxy/server.py:1318-1338, sahi_adapter.py:202-205), and it subscribes nothing.

The MCX row is in the case's master so the web replay can name it; Sahi's own master has no MCX rows, and there the desktop answers today with the item message "Token not found for CRUDEOIL25NOVFUT on MCX".
